-- IGProtocol scaffold: VINIT → CLINK → FSPLIT → EVALT → AFWD → IMSCRIB → FSPLIT → EVALT → EVALF → FFUSE → EVALF → AREV → FFUSE → ENGAGR → IFIX → TANCH
-- (native ob3ect designer; elaborate against the kernel to verify)
name: test factorization helper
notes:
Auto-designed from: Design an Ob3ect for:

test factorization helper

phase_0.boundary_condition: factored test suite plus helper module closed under a single test runner invocation
phase_0.justification: Auto-designed by the native Ob3ect Auto-Designer (in-process candle, no Python)

AFWD.chosen_element: extraction of common setup into parameterized helper call
AFWD.justification: moves duplicated arrange blocks forward into a single callable that accepts varying inputs

AREV.chosen_element: return of singleton tests to the suite unchanged
AREV.justification: steps back from transformation when no repetition exists and preserves original test text

CLINK.chosen_element: chaining of parser, clone detector, and rewriter
CLINK.justification: links collection, comparison, and code generation into one ordered pipeline

ENGAGR.chosen_element: old duplicated code and new helper call held as equivalent
ENGAGR.justification: keeps both forms present during equivalence check, asserting same behavior from different text

EVALF.justification: negative state where a test lacks a partner and cannot support extraction

EVALT.chosen_element: clone cluster confirmed with matching assertions
EVALT.justification: affirmative state where two or more tests share setup and expected shape

FFUSE.chosen_element: merge of rewritten parameterized tests and preserved singletons
FFUSE.justification: rejoins both arms into one suite file set that runs under a single test command

FSPLIT.chosen_element: division of suite into factorable clusters and singletons
FSPLIT.justification: opens one incoming test list into two processing arms based on repetition count

IFIX.chosen_element: written helper module and migration log
IFIX.justification: append only record of helper source and which tests were rewritten that cannot be edited in place

IMSCRIB.chosen_element: helper self reference across call sites
IMSCRIB.justification: each generated call points back to the same helper definition, marking the helper as itself

TANCH.chosen_element: factored suite with helper committed and runner finished
TANCH.justification: closed archive holds final helper plus all rewritten and untouched tests as one shippable set

VINIT.justification: no test names, duplicates, or helpers have been named yet, so the helper starts from empty inventory

phase_2.fuse_element: merge of rewritten parameterized tests and preserved singletons
phase_2.fuse_result: unified factored suite ready for test run
phase_2.rejoin_note: extraction and parameterization run on the factorable arm while identity preservation runs on the singleton arm, then both rejoin into one suite; kernel computes verdict over SIXTEEN_3.
phase_2.split_element: division of suite into factorable clusters and singletons
phase_2.split_input: collected test ASTs with duplication scores
phase_2.verdict_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.both_description: B4 B (11) both held at once: original and factored forms assert together as equivalent yet textually distinct
phase_3.false_description: B4 F (10) constructively refuted: no factorable duplication in the examined test
phase_3.true_description: B4 T (01) constructively proven: duplication confirmed and factored form passes
phase_3.void_description: B4 N (00) neither: uninitialized, nothing established before test scan

steps.domain_action: unfactored test directory arrives before inventory
parse test files and chain clone detection to rewrite planning
divide collected tests into factorable clusters and singletons
confirm repeated setup and assertion shape in cluster arm
extract common setup into parameterized helper call
link each new call site back to the single helper definition
open equivalence check into passing behavior arm and failing behavior arm
factored test passes with same assertions as original
factored test fails and signals divergence from original
rejoin passing and failing checks into one verified helper revision
mark singleton tests with no partner for preservation
return singleton tests to suite unchanged
merge rewritten parameterized tests and preserved singletons into unified suite
hold original duplicated text and factored helper as behaviorally equivalent
commit helper module and migration log to append only store
seal factored suite and helper as closed runnable set

phase_5.alfs_store: canonical test pattern library holding approved helper templates and assertion shapes
phase_5.compiler_frontend: test parser that translates duplicated test text into cluster specs and helper signatures
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: AST exchange and call site references between detector, extractor, and rewriter
phase_5.memory_mechanism: in memory clone index plus on disk helper module and rewritten test files
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: clone detector ordering that processes largest repetition clusters first

phase_6.cycle_cost: parser cycles, comparison operations, and file writes per factorization run
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — duplication removed from test bodies equals structure added in helper module
phase_6.post_cycle_state: suite with centralized helper and deduplicated call sites
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: suite with scattered duplicates and no shared helper
